name: DungParty
summary: 🎶 This is a "flavorful" adventure and carnival! Transform into a hardworking (and persistent) dung beetle in the microscopic world, immersing yourself in simulating the life of a dung beetle. Use your pincers to grip the ground and crawl, keep pushing dung balls with all your strength using your forelegs, or grab dung balls to hurl them as weapons at enemies!
